title: Harmonic analysis and circuit approximation of Sobolev functions on quantum input spaces
abstract: arXiv:2610.13477v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We derive approximation rates for Sobolev functions defined on the complex unit sphere and complex projective space, representing quantum states, and on the special and projective unitary groups, representing quantum unitary operations. By using harmonic analysis on compact groups and compact homogeneous spaces, we characterize the corresponding Peter--Weyl decompositions and Sobolev spaces via irreducible representations and the Laplace--Beltrami operator. Combining spectral truncation with finite-depth quantum-circuit approximation, invoking the Solovay--Kitaev theorem, we establish quantitative rates that separate the spectral truncation error from the circuit approximation error.

translated_title: 量子输入空间上Sobolev函数的调和分析与量子电路逼近
translated_abstract: 我们推导了定义在表示量子态的复单位球面与复射影空间上、以及表示量子幺正操作的特殊幺正群与射影幺正群上的Sobolev函数的逼近速率。通过利用紧群与紧齐性空间上的调和分析，我们借助不可约表示和Laplace–Beltrami算子刻画了相应的Peter–Weyl分解与Sobolev空间。结合谱截断与有限深度量子电路逼近（并援引Solovay–Kitaev定理），我们建立了能够将谱截断误差与电路逼近误差分离的定量逼近速率。
tldr: 该论文通过紧群上的调和分析刻画了量子态与量子幺正操作所在空间上Sobolev函数的Peter–Weyl分解，并结合谱截断与基于Solovay–Kitaev定理的有限深度量子电路逼近，建立了将谱截断误差与电路逼近误差分离的定量逼近速率。
en_tdlr: Using harmonic analysis on compact groups, this paper characterizes Peter–Weyl decompositions of Sobolev functions on quantum state and unitary operation spaces, and establishes quantitative approximation rates that separate spectral truncation error from circuit approximation error by combining spectral truncation with finite-depth quantum circuit approximation via the Solovay–Kitaev theorem.
